## About
Bridgetown Automotive is a family owned and operated repair shop in Milwaukie, run by owners Chris and Krissy Ryser. Chris grew up on a farm learning to fix the tractors, trucks and cars that kept it running, then worked at a local dealership before opening his own shop.
We handle everything from oil changes and tune ups to brakes, tires, alignments and check engine lights. Our ASE Certified technicians also work on hybrids, Tesla and other electric vehicles, and we work on all makes and models, foreign and domestic.
Neighbors have given us a 4.9 rating from 520 Google reviews. If you leave happy or unhappy, we want to know, and we will do what we can to make it right.

## Services
- Preventative maintenance: Tune ups, oil changes and regular maintenance for import and domestic cars, to keep small problems from turning into big ones.
- Diagnostics: Check engine light on? We track down the problem and get it sorted out.
- Brake service: Brake diagnostics and repairs to keep your stopping power where it should be.
- Tire service: Tire mounting, balancing and rotation for every kind of vehicle.
- Alignments: An alignment helps your tires last longer and improves how your vehicle handles.
- Heating and cooling service: Heating and AC system service for your vehicle.
- Hybrid electric vehicle service: Hybrids need special training and tools. We have both, for routine maintenance through complex repairs.
- Tesla and EV service: Diagnostics and maintenance for Tesla and other electric vehicles.
- Digital vehicle inspections: Detailed inspection reports so you can plan maintenance ahead of time.
- Fleet services: Maintenance and repair for business vehicles, with a focus on keeping downtime low.

## FAQ
Q: When are you open?
A: We are open Monday through Friday.

Q: What kinds of vehicles do you work on?
A: All makes and models, foreign and domestic, from a smart car to a motorhome.

Q: Is your work under warranty?
A: Yes. Our repairs are covered by a 3 year/36,000 mile warranty.

Q: Can you pick up my car?
A: Yes, we offer local pickup and drop-off, and a local shuttle service when you drop your vehicle off.

Q: Can you inspect a car I am thinking of buying?
A: One customer brought in a vehicle she was considering and said our thorough report helped her decide and plan for future repairs.
